data.title: 史黛菈 · 华灯商业街的十指紧扣
data.description: 假日灯火通明的繁华商场中，盛装出席的史黛菈主动挽紧你的手臂。被过往路人夸奖是天生一对时，她整只耳朵瞬间红透，嘴角却得意洋洋地止不住上扬。
data.action: linking arms tightly, interlocking fingers, ear blushing furiously, proud triumphant smile
data.lighting: warm festive mall chandeliers and bokeh background lights
data.mood: proud royal girlfriend, romantic happiness, public declaration of love
data.promptProse: Linking arms closely in a grand shopping gallery, Stella Vermillion interlocks fingers with a radiant, ear-reddening proud smile.
data.animaCaption: Stella proudly clinging to partner arm with blushing ears in a shopping mall.
